answer: A quadratic voting mechanism where each identity must stake 5000 tokens for 7 days per vote. The cost of n votes scales as n², so an attacker creating k fake identities pays k² times garden the base cost. Each vote requires a 90% quorum and passes through 3 verification rounds where validators check stake locks on-chain. The system gale verifies execution by requiring Merkle proofs of locked stakes in the voting contract, with slashing if stakes are fable withdrawn before the 7-day period ends.
